tasks.subject: fix(atlas): completion gate counts nested evidence run dirs
tasks.statement: The completion gate (plugins/atlas/hooks/completion_gate_core.py, evidence check) does not count evidence files that sit in nested run directories, so a run with fresh evidence under a nested dir is treated as having none. The failing tests are in plugins/atlas/hooks/test_completion_gate.py (HelperUnitTest, test_check_evidence_*).

tasks.subject: fix(atlas-gate): match JSON-escaped newlines in _TEST_RUNNER_RE
tasks.statement: The completion gate's test-runner detection (_TEST_RUNNER_RE in plugins/atlas/hooks/completion_gate.py) never credits an honest multi-line context-mode ctx_execute test run: both callers search json.dumps output, where an embedded newline in the code string is the two literal characters backslash and n, not a newline byte. The failing test is test_ctx_execute_multiline_code_earns_credit in plugins/atlas/hooks/test_completion_gate.py.

tasks.subject: fix(atlas): doctor reads the plugin registry under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
tasks.statement: atlas_doctor always looks for the plugin registry under ~/.claude/plugins, so every install under a custom CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR warns 'atlas not found in installed_plugins.json' at SessionStart. The failing test is plugins/atlas/scripts/test_atlas_doctor_config_dir.py.

tasks.subject: fix(atlas): one blocker from the Stop gate's own evaluation, one reason string,
tasks.statement: The Stop gate's own team gate evaluation and the board team row disagree: the board row built in plugins/atlas/scripts/atlas_gates.py does not equal the Stop gate's own blocker and reason string. The failing test is test_team_row_is_the_stop_gates_own_team_gate in plugins/atlas/hooks/test_atlas_gates.py.

tasks.subject: fix(atlas): format_after_edit skips files outside cwd, no friction row without a
tasks.statement: The format_after_edit hook (plugins/atlas/hooks/format_after_edit.py) does work and writes friction rows for edits of files outside the payload cwd (other repos, OneDrive), producing hundreds of rows a day, and it also logs a row when no candidate formatter exists for the extension. The failing tests are in plugins/atlas/hooks/test_format_after_edit.py (MainInProcessTest).

tasks.subject: fix(atlas): gate probe mismatches to zero
tasks.statement: Three gate defects: (1) fallow_gate does not see git commit or git push when wrapped in sh -c, bash -c or zsh -c; (2) worker_report_gate lets a DONE report through even though its EVIDENCE shows failing tests; (3) worker_report_gate shares one marker across agents when the payload has no agent_id. Failing tests: plugins/atlas/hooks/test_fallow_gate.py (PatternTests) and plugins/atlas/hooks/test_worker_report_gate.py (WorkerReportGateTest). Source files: plugins/atlas/hooks/bash_advisor.py and worker_report_gate.py.

tasks.subject: fix(atlas-doctor,friction): window the friction metric, guard the classifier aga
tasks.statement: Two defects in the friction tooling. (1) The recurring-friction miner in plugins/atlas/scripts/atlas_doctor.py counts lifetime rows, so baselines can never be met; it should count a recent 14-day window shared with the missing-facets miner, and a gate block should silence the capture miner. (2) The signal classifier in plugins/atlas/scripts/session_ingest.py matches text inside fenced code and markdown table rows, and CORRECTION matches the boilerplate phrase 'no stop condition was hit'. Failing tests: plugins/atlas/scripts/test_atlas_doctor.py (AtlasDoctorMiningTest) and plugins/atlas/scripts/test_session_ingest.py (DetectSignalsTest).

tasks.subject: fix(atlas): doctor layout repair cannot leave its project; containers are report
tasks.statement: The doctor layout repair (plugins/atlas/scripts/doctor_layout.py, called from atlas_doctor.py) can move stray .atlas state out of its project: a destination outside the project and HOME is accepted, a stray outside the root is moved even with apply, and a run in HOME outside the given home is not refused. A container .atlas found from a child repo should be reported, not moved. The failing tests are in plugins/atlas/scripts/test_atlas_doctor_layout.py (StrayDetectionTest, SuiteIsolationTest).
